# PhoneBridge 0.6.3

## 中文

修复 Android“关于 → 应用更新”在已是最新版本时仍显示“下载 APK”的问题。

- 当前版本与发布版本相同或更高时，仅保留“检查更新”。
- 只有原生更新器确认存在更高版本时，才显示下载或安装入口。
- 不再提示安装已包含在当前版本中的缓存 APK；未能确认更新状态时也隐藏下载入口。
- 保留新版下载进度、失败重试、安装权限和系统安装界面流程。

这是 Android 的界面修复。Windows 和 Mac 继续使用 0.6.2，本次不重发桌面安装包。

## English

Fix Android About → App update offering “Download APK” when the installed version is already current or newer. Only a confirmed newer Android version enables download/install actions. Check for updates remains available. Cached current APKs and unknown update availability no longer show download/install prompts. Existing download progress, retry and installer flows are preserved.

This is an Android-only patch. Desktop clients remain at 0.6.2.

## Verification

Flutter analysis and all 89 mobile tests passed. The equal/newer-version regressions reproduce the previous bug before the fix. Coverage includes cached current APKs, unknown availability and existing progress/retry/install behavior. Focused independent code review passed.

The ARM64 release APK uses versionName 0.6.3 and versionCode 4021, retaining the preview certificate 8ce72b7e5687933ea65307b99d3e2b1e41c837a26d18740f9dbc72aeb0bcdbc0. Size: 38,227,792 bytes. SHA-256: e4193b2ec00131719a30ceb5927516c31ee4f24da028dda6e0fc9b044628afad.

ADB updated the connected Xiaomi Android 16 phone in place. Its actual About screen shows current 0.6.3 / latest 0.6.2 with only Check for updates, and its saved pairing reconnected. No downgrade or data reset was performed.

This remains a developer preview using the existing signing identity.
